newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Kocbank secures $75 mln syndication loan.
newsitem.headline: Turk Kocbank secures $75 mln syndication loan.

text.p: Turkey's Kocbank, owned by leading industrial conglomerate Koc Holding, said on Wednesday it signed a $75 million sydication loan agreement in London this week.
The one-year syndication, with an interest rate of LIBOR (London Interbank Offered Rate) plus 50 basis points, would be used in export financing, Kocbank said in a statement faxed to Reuters.
The deal was arranged by American Express Bank, Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi and Sanwa Bank with the participation of 17 international banks.
